audit.why: 45.41% over 577 games — the worst matchup in this slice. Levels 1-2 before Purge are the only free window; from 4 onward his sustained DPS and armour beat a zero-defence caster.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart reads Skill|Urgot|Urgot|Urgot|Urgot|Urgot|Skill, but whys[0] says you 'out-range his clunky early', whys[1] calls level 2 'your hardest favor window', whys[2] calls level 3 'a genuine coin-flip', and whys[6] says a two-item Urgot is one 'your squishy frame can't kill'.
audit.why: The chart gives Urgot the two levels the text calls free and gives Jayce a share of the two-item stage the text calls unwinnable. Packet reference chart Jayce|Jayce|Skill|Urgot|Urgot|Urgot|Urgot matches every caption.
audit.corrected: Sides re-set to Jayce, Jayce, Skill, Urgot, Urgot, Urgot, Urgot.

audit.whatIsWrong: Six fields say Purge and his legs deal 'percent-max-HP' damage. Riot's text does not say that anywhere: Purge 'unloads his weapon on nearby enemies' and Echoing Flames 'deals physical damage'. The kit file carries no percentHealth flag for Urgot at all. Two real interactions ARE missing: Purge 'prioritizes enemy champions Urgot has recently struck with other abilities', and Purge 'slows himself while he unloads'. Disdain also shields him on the charge.
audit.why: Percent-health damage is an itemisation claim — it tells the player armour is pointless, which is the opposite of true here. The real facts are actionable: a landed Corrosive Charge is the tell that Purge is about to lock onto you, and because Purge slows Urgot, walking out of it beats trading through it. The Disdain shield explains why your poke into his charge feels like it does nothing.
audit.corrected: Percent-HP claims replaced with the Purge targeting rule and its self-slow; Disdain's shield stated in mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page says to trade 'when his Disdain is on cooldown' without a number.
audit.why: Disdain is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s, Corrosive Charge 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s, Fear Beyond Death 100/85/70s, and Purge runs 12/9/6/3/0s so by rank 5 it is permanently available. The 16s Disdain at rank 1 is the only real window.
audit.corrected: 16s Disdain stated in early and mid.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 are your whole lane: take Shock Blast (Q) and fire it through your Acceleration Gate (E) to poke his step-ups before his W (Purge) is up. Right now his shotgun legs only trigger off his own ability casts and his early is clunky, so you out-range him cleanly. The instant he points Purge at level 3, his legs auto-fire onto you on every cast and any walk-up trade bleeds percent-max-HP back into him faster than your orb chips. Keep Thundering Blow (E) loaded in Hammer form to knock him out of his Disdain (E) charge — that flip is his only way to close on you, and denying it is your single best play. Do NOT brawl him in melee form; you have no armor and his shotgun blasts shred percent-HP.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are your whole lane: take Shock Blast (Q) and fire it through your Acceleration Gate (E) to poke his step-ups before his W (Purge) is up. Right now his shotgun legs only trigger off his own ability casts and his early is clunky, so you out-range him cleanly. From level 3 Purge auto-fires his legs, and it PRIORITISES champions he has just struck with another ability — a landed Corrosive Charge is the tell the DPS is aimed at you. Purge also slows Urgot while it runs, so walking out beats trading through it. Keep Thundering Blow (E) loaded in Hammer form to knock him out of his 16s Disdain charge — that flip is his only way to close on you.

edits.before: This is where it slips. By 4-5 he has Purge plus a Q rank, and his percent-HP DPS in a sustained fight stat-checks your squishy frame even when you land a full Cannon-to-Hammer combo. At 6 his R (Fear Beyond Death) flips you and executes below the threshold, so you cannot sit low or facecheck him — one Disdain-flip into Purge can chunk you straight into execute range. Your gate-Q still pokes, but you're now chipping a tankier target who heals it back through the wave and answers every step-up with auto-firing legs. Only trade when his Disdain (E) is on cooldown, and never let him flip you near your own tower for plate gold.

edits.after: With Purge plus a Q rank his sustained leg DPS out-trades your full combo, and Purge homes on whoever he last hit with Corrosive Charge — that is you.

edits.before: He puts a point in Purge (W) and now auto-fires his shotgun legs at you on every cast — your gate-Q still chips, but a walk-up trade now bleeds percent-max-HP back into him.

notes: Urgot's kit carries no percent-max-health damage in Riot's text or in the kit file's derived flags, yet six fields on this page told the player his legs shred percent HP. That is an itemisation-level error: it argues armour is useless when armour is exactly what this matchup wants. Replaced with the two real interactions — Purge prioritises targets he has just hit with another ability, and Purge slows Urgot while it channels. late still contains one 'percent-HP' phrase; it needed a larger restructure than the band allowed and is worth a follow-up.
